notes: This fixture interprets 'incomplete timestamps' as the extreme case: no timestamp signal anywhere in the source. Plain .txt input bypasses VTT cue formatting entirely (decodeRawTranscript in src/prompt.ts returns raw text unmodified for non-VTT sources), so the model has no timestamps to report and per the prompt rule must omit/empty the field rather than fabricate one.
